lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
A 45-year-old woman is facing drug trafficking and firearm charges following an RCMP investigation on Flying Dust First Nation, The Canadian Press reports.

News of Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia sent the stock market soaring Monday morning, with shares of the technology company up roughly 30 per cent after a volatile 11 days, The Canadian Press reports.
South Korea’s military said Tuesday that several Russian aircraft flew inside the country’s air defence identification zone over waters, prompting an alert, The Associated Press reports.
A federal appeals court on Monday declined to block the Army from detonating explosives containing lead azide at a munitions plant in Iowa, CBS News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
